name: services/events/test_my_fcm
description:
Test your FCM instances by sending a notification with supplied message. The notification payload will be
        consistent with a real notification.
brief_description: Send a notification to your FCM instances

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: A message payload to send in the notification

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.
